facts.F1: The Applicant, Brar Lakhvir Singh, applied for compensation under the Employees' Compensation Ordinance for an alleged accident on 13th September 2008 while working at Hon Man Environmental Trading Company Limited.
facts.F2: The Respondent challenged the Applicant's claim, stating that the Applicant did not have an accident on 13th September 2008.
facts.F3: The Applicant commenced working for the Respondent on 8th September 2008 with a monthly salary of HK$9,000 and a monthly food allowance of HK$700.
facts.F4: The Applicant's main duty was to operate the compressor machine.
facts.F5: On 13th September 2008, at about 8:10 am, the Applicant's boss asked him to operate the machine again.
facts.F6: At about 10:00 am, while the Applicant was using his right hand to push the plastic scrap into the collection chamber, a Chinese worker who was deaf and dumb touched the machine.
facts.F7: The material part in the Applicant's witness statement described the accident as follows: 'At about 10:00 am, I had filled the collection chamber with plastic scrap and I was using my right hand to push back the plastic scrap into the collection chamber. As I was doing so the other Chinese worker with disability came and without giving me any indication switched on the compressor machine and the compressing board started to move downwards.'
facts.F8: The Applicant's version of the accident was inconsistent with his original claim.
facts.F9: The Respondent's evidence showed that there was no accident on 13th September 2008.
facts.F10: The Applicant took 2 hours of rest after the alleged accident and then cleaned up the place and left at about 7:00 pm.
facts.F11: On 14th September 2008, the Applicant resumed duty as usual with a bandage around his right hand.
facts.F12: The Applicant was told by RW1 that there was no more work for him and he would call him again for work later.
facts.F13: The Applicant then approached RW2, who told him that there was nothing she could do.
facts.F14: The Applicant went to the Queen Elizabeth Hospital (QEH) Accident and Emergency Department on 16th September 2008 for consultation.
facts.F15: Upon examination, there was tenderness over the right wrist, but X-rays showed no bony fracture.
facts.F16: Sick leaves were given for 16th to 19th September 2008.
facts.F17: The Applicant repeatedly attended QEH A & E for treatment and was given sick leaves from time to time until 7th November 2008.
facts.F18: On or about 10th November 2008, the Applicant changed to Yau Ma Tei Jockey Club General Out-patient clinic for treatment and was given sick leaves from time to time until 21st May 2009.
facts.F19: As at the date of the Applicant's statement dated 11th May 2009, he still had pain over his right hand and wrist and he could hardly lift up heavy objects above 5 kg in weight.
facts.F20: The Applicant spent $4,000 on medical expenses.
facts.F21: Dr. Wong's opinion stated that the Applicant's condition was quite static since the first consultation and that he did not have any serious objective pathology.
